ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, four points A, B, C, and D form a cycle. A is at the lower left, B is at the lower right, C is at the upper right, and D is at the upper left; the downward arrow from D to A on the left side is labeled ①, the horizontal arrow from A to B at the bottom is labeled ②, the upward arrow from B to C on the right side is labeled ③, and the horizontal arrow from C to D at the top is labeled ④. Then reason: If this figure represents the water cycle between sea and land, the water flow at the bottom returning toward the ocean can correspond to the runoff link. The "thousand gullies and ten thousand ravines" surface morphology of the Loess Plateau is mainly closely related to fluvial erosion and surface runoff, so it corresponds to ② in the figure.
